sourceNotes.rawContent:
Step into timeless elegance with this Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Bracelet Watch, featuring a stunning emerald green dial, classic Roman numeral detailing and a sleek multi-link bracelet. The rich green dial paired with the golden finish gives this watch a sophisticated, vintage-inspired look.
The unique rectangular dial adds a modern touch to its classic design, while the elegant gold-tone bracelet makes it look like a beautiful piece of jewellery on your wrist. Perfect for women who love stylish, statement-making accessories that can effortlessly complement both ethnic and western outfits.
Product Highlights
- ✨ Vintage-inspired design
- 💛 Anti-tarnish gold-tone finish
- 💚 Elegant green dial
- 🕰️ Classic Roman numeral hour markers
- 🔗 Detailed multi-link bracelet strap
- ⌚ Quartz movement
- 💎 Jewellery-inspired statement watch
- 👗 Perfect for ethnic and western outfits
- 🎁 Ideal gifting option for women
- ✨ Suitable for everyday wear and special occasions
Perfect For
College, office, casual outings, festive occasions, parties, date nights, weddings and gifting.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
